what: Cards know their job (#3658 / #2347 / #2390): a job's result or a message of `agent_job.py say ID "text"` that ends in ```approval becomes an approval card linked to that job (job_id, job.json cards), ```suggest becomes buttons, ```approval-done closes the job's own cards; a result that asks without a card but has exactly ONE suggestion: the suggestion (up to 200 characters) becomes the card; Yes / No on a job's card goes to that job, never to the chat agent: into its inbox while it runs, or it wakes the ended job once in its session (--wake); a job that cannot take it: the chat run as before; only the job's person or an operator (account id) reaches the inbox / decides the card, anyone else: the chat run, their text as data
